consumer_contract: one entry per design (set_id, design_id, label, geometry, design values, x_w, axis nulls, wall cusps with z_c / |B| / angle, cells with mirror descriptors, per-cusp Koch rho readings, hemp_like_all_cusps, inside_sweep_v2_box, stable flag) so a future wall-loss screening can stratify its launch design by regime (sweep-v2 region vs HEMP-like) and define cells by actual separatrix intersections; consumers must carry the label SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_SEPARATRIX_CUSP_TOPOLOGY and must not read rho or the mirror descriptors as probabilities
definition: wall cusp := intersection of the separatrix of an axis null with the straight dielectric wall (cusp topology search v3.1 definition, imported); rho := |B|(r_w, z_c) / adjacent axis |B_z| peak (Koch et al. IEPC-2007-110 design ratio; see protocol.json#descriptors_v3)
hemp_like_rule: a design is HEMP-like iff it has at least one wall cusp inside the straight dielectric and every such cusp has rho_conservative >= 1.5 (the lower end of the DM9-1 anode cusp value 1.53 in Koch's Table 1, rounded)
